name: Grade 7 IIIT Practice: November Week 11 - Debug Reliability
description: Practice words for retesting and improving reliability.

words.definition: To find and fix a problem in code.
words.example: The team debugged the code after the signal did not appear.

words.definition: To test again after making a change.
words.example: The team retested after changing the threshold.

words.definition: Working in a steady and dependable way.
words.example: The system was stable when it worked three times in a row.

words.definition: Not working in a steady or dependable way.
words.example: The system was unstable when the signal changed randomly.

words.definition: A small change made to improve something.
words.example: A small adjustment made the threshold more accurate.

words.definition: A record of tests, changes, and notes.
words.example: The logbook recorded the problem, change, and retest result.
